desc_lfm_album: Aquarium is the debut studio album by Danish-Norwegian band Aqua, released on 26 March 1997. Although the group had been together for three years under their original name Joyspeed, their only release under that name was a single called "Itzy Bitzy Spider". The album is best known for including the successful single "Barbie Girl" which went on to become a widely recognizable hit around the world, as well as the singles "Doctor Jones" and "Turn Back Time". The album was preceded by the single "Roses Are Red" followed by the single "My Oh My", which was released a second time .

Aqua is a name shared by multiple music groups from different countries and genres.

1. Aqua is Danish-Norwegian dance-pop group formed in 1989 originally under the name Joyspeed, later renamed Aqua in 1994. They gained international fame in the late 1990s and early 2000s with hits such as "Barbie Girl." Their first three singles reached number one on the UK Singles Chart. They released two albums, "Aquarium" in 1997 and "Aquarius" in 2000, before disbanding in 2001.
